stem.text: The equation shows a gas phase reaction.
The diagram shows the Boltzmann distribution of a fixed mass of $\text{X(g)}$ at temperature $T$ in the absence of a catalyst. The line $E_\text{A}$ indicates the activation energy.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution curve: proportion of molecules with a given energy against molecular energy. The curve rises to a single peak and then falls with a long tail. A dashed vertical line marks E_A on the molecular energy axis.

stem.text: Which diagrams correctly show the effect of the following changes made separately and independently?

items.alt: Boltzmann distribution curve with the same shape and axes as the original diagram. The dashed E_A line is shifted to the left, at a lower molecular energy.
Boltzmann distribution curve with the same axes and E_A line as the original diagram. The curve is unchanged from the original.

Two Boltzmann distribution curves with the same axes and E_A line. The solid curve is labelled temperature T. The dashed curve is labelled temperature T' with (T' > T); its peak is higher and lies to the right of the solid peak, and more molecules have energies above E_A.
